highlights.title: Databricks adoption.
highlights.description: Led the architecture, implementation, and migration of a 4.7 PB data platform. Moved company-wide analytics first while keeping existing batch jobs running. Addressed compatibility and performance issues and phased the data and batch migration to manage cost and operational risk.

highlights.title: Company-wide Airflow platform.
highlights.description: Built a Kubernetes-based Airflow platform for all internal data platform users. Improved security and governance with authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA).

highlights.title: Data pipeline workload standardization.
highlights.description: Unified Spark job submission across EMR and Databricks and migrated selected batch workloads. Added lineage for EMR Spark jobs and laid the groundwork for standardized resource configuration and AI automation.

highlights.title: Pipeline cost optimization.
highlights.description: Established per-application cost monitoring and optimized high-cost applications while preserving business logic.

highlights.title: Knowledge graph platform.
highlights.description: Evaluated triple stores and graph databases, implemented knowledge graph reasoning, and built data processing for the search engine.

highlights.title: Knowledge graph streaming pipelines.
highlights.description: Built Kafka and Spring Cloud Data Flow pipelines that transform and load source data into the knowledge graph, with autoscaling for pipeline applications.

highlights.title: Web search crawler.
highlights.description: Designed and developed a new crawler and operated a crawler covering 1.3 million URLs and 1.5 TB of data. Refactored legacy code and automated monitoring.

highlights.title: Crawler infrastructure migration.
highlights.description: Built a 33-node on-premises Hadoop, HBase, and Spark cluster and migrated data to it. Replaced MapReduce jobs with Spark, increasing processing speed to about 4× its previous level.

experience.description: Built a Python and Flask web tool to load file-based data into a relational database.
Automated IoT data extraction and loading, and developed web APIs.
